x: Walkers to join us recently are: L.
Lee, of Ashcombe A.C., ran a very plucky race and deserved his victory in what was quite good time. The 2 Miles Walk saw Ashcmbe A.C. gaining first two places with L.

The time of the winner was 9 mins. 43 secs., and considering the heavy going this was quite a sound performance. In the 3 Miles Walk we saw a fine performance by Len Fletcher who, off 20 yds., finished second to L.
Our very best wishes for future happiness go to L.
